*Story:* As an Onboarding Analyst, I want to send the KYC document request to the new client through the client portal, so that the client knows exactly which documents to send and where, helping us cut the time it takes to complete KYC for a new client.

*Priority:* must · *Control:* Automated. Exception 'No documents after 10 working days' goes to Engagement Manager
*Change from today:* Automated by suggestion S01 (today: manual, ~10 min per case)

h3. Acceptance criteria
*AC1 – No documents after 10 working days puts onboarding on hold* (edge case)
* *Given* a client who has not sent their KYC documents 10 working days after the request
* *When* the daily overdue check runs
* *Then* the engagement manager is notified
* *And* onboarding for the client is set to on hold
*AC2 – Document request sent through the portal* (happy path)
* *Given* a new client record in the CRM
* *When* KYC starts
* *Then* the client receives a portal request listing photo ID and proof of address for each director and owner
* *And* the request is due 5 working days after sending

h3. Edge cases and exceptions
* No documents after 10 working days: escalate; notify Engagement Manager
* No documents after 10 working days puts onboarding on hold: see acceptance criterion

h3. Data
* Client (read): crm_id, legal_name, country_risk
* KYC documents (write): photo_ids, proof_of_address, received_at

h3. Non-functional
* [security] KYC documents are visible only to onboarding and compliance
* [audit] Every check, result and approval is kept as evidence for 5 years after the relationship ends
* [volume] About 150 new clients a month, roughly double in April and May

*Story:* As an Onboarding Analyst, I want to verify each identity document through the e-ID verification service API, so that identities are verified in minutes, not by hand, helping us cut the time it takes to complete KYC for a new client and focus analyst time on the cases that need a human.

*Priority:* must · *Control:* Automated. Exception 'ID check failed' goes to Onboarding Analyst
*Change from today:* Automated by suggestion S03 (today: manual, ~20 min per case)

h3. Acceptance criteria
*AC1 – Failed ID check goes to an analyst* (edge case)
* *Given* an expired passport for one director
* *When* the identity documents are verified
* *Then* the case is placed in the analyst's queue with the reason
* *And* screening does not start until the analyst clears it
*AC2 – Valid ID is verified automatically* (happy path)
* *Given* a valid passport for each director
* *When* the identity documents are verified
* *Then* a verification result is recorded for each director
* *And* the case moves on to screening

h3. Edge cases and exceptions
* ID check failed: manual review; notify Onboarding Analyst
* Failed ID check goes to an analyst: see acceptance criterion

h3. Data
* KYC documents (read): photo_ids, proof_of_address, received_at

h3. Non-functional

* [volume] About 150 new clients a month, roughly double in April and May

*Story:* As an Onboarding Analyst, I want to screen the client and every director in one batch through the screening tool's API, so that every client and owner is screened consistently in one go, helping us cut the time it takes to complete KYC for a new client and focus analyst time on the cases that need a human.

*Priority:* must · *Control:* Automated + human review — reviewer: Onboarding Analyst (on exception). Checks: Each possible match is confirmed or cleared before the case moves on
*Change from today:* Automated with review by suggestion S04 (today: manual, ~25 min per case)

h3. Acceptance criteria
*AC1 – Clean screening moves on automatically* (happy path)
* *Given* a client and owners with no possible matches
* *When* screening runs
* *Then* the screening result is saved to the client file
* *And* the case moves on to the risk rating
*AC2 – Possible match is reviewed by an analyst* (edge case)
* *Given* a director with a possible PEP match
* *When* screening runs
* *Then* the case waits for an analyst to confirm or clear the match
* *And* the analyst's decision and reason are saved

h3. Edge cases and exceptions
* Possible match is reviewed by an analyst: see acceptance criterion

h3. Data
* Client (read): crm_id, legal_name, country_risk
* Screening result (write): sanctions_match, pep_match, adverse_media, match_score

h3. Non-functional
* [security] KYC documents are visible only to onboarding and compliance
* [audit] Every check, result and approval is kept as evidence for 5 years after the relationship ends
* [volume] About 150 new clients a month, roughly double in April and May

*Story:* As an Onboarding Analyst, I want to apply the KYC risk rating rule to the screening result and client country, and record the reason, so that every client gets the same rating for the same facts, helping us focus analyst time on the cases that need a human.

*Priority:* must · *Control:* Automated
*Change from today:* Automated by suggestion S05 (today: manual, ~10 min per case)

h3. Acceptance criteria
*AC1 – Sanctions match or PEP gives high risk* (edge case)
* *Given* a screening result where a director is a PEP
* *When* the risk rating is assigned
* *Then* the risk rating is high
* *And* the case goes to the MLRO for approval
*AC2 – Clean screening gives low risk* (happy path)
* *Given* a screening result with no sanctions match, no PEP and no adverse media
* *And* the client's country risk is standard
* *When* the risk rating is assigned
* *Then* the risk rating is low
* *And* the case goes straight to recording
*AC3 – Adverse media gives medium risk* (edge case)
* *Given* a screening result with adverse media but no sanctions match or PEP
* *When* the risk rating is assigned
* *Then* the risk rating is medium
* *And* the case goes to an analyst for approval

h3. Edge cases and exceptions
* Sanctions match or PEP gives high risk: see acceptance criterion
* Adverse media gives medium risk: see acceptance criterion

h3. Business rules
* KYC risk rating: sanctions_match=true → high; pep_match=true → high; adverse_media=true → medium; country_risk=high → medium; otherwise → low

h3. Data
* Client (read): crm_id, legal_name, country_risk
* Risk assessment (read/write): rating, reason, approved_by, approved_at
* Screening result (read): sanctions_match, pep_match, adverse_media, match_score

h3. Non-functional

* [audit] Every check, result and approval is kept as evidence for 5 years after the relationship ends
* [volume] About 150 new clients a month, roughly double in April and May

*Story:* As an Onboarding Analyst, I want to write the KYC outcome to the CRM and file the documents and screening results to the client file, so that the evidence is on the client file without rekeying and onboarding can continue, helping us cut the time it takes to complete KYC for a new client.

*Priority:* must · *Control:* Automated. Exception 'CRM unavailable' goes to Onboarding Analyst
*Change from today:* Automated by suggestion S06 (today: manual, ~15 min per case)

h3. Acceptance criteria
*AC1 – CRM outage retries, then goes to an analyst* (edge case)
* *Given* the CRM is unavailable when a KYC outcome is ready to record
* *When* the outcome is recorded
* *Then* recording is retried up to 3 times
* *And* after the third failure the case is placed in the analyst's queue
* *And* nothing is marked KYC complete until the CRM write succeeds
*AC2 – KYC outcome and evidence recorded* (happy path)
* *Given* a client whose rating is low, or approved where needed
* *When* the KYC outcome is recorded
* *Then* the CRM shows KYC complete with the rating
* *And* the documents, screening results and approvals are kept on the client file

h3. Edge cases and exceptions
* CRM unavailable: manual review; notify Onboarding Analyst
* CRM outage retries, then goes to an analyst: see acceptance criterion

h3. Data
* KYC documents (read): photo_ids, proof_of_address, received_at
* Risk assessment (read): rating, reason, approved_by, approved_at
* Screening result (read): sanctions_match, pep_match, adverse_media, match_score
